old:

    offY = sy * IC_SLICE_PX;

old: return { ...p, x: offX + p.x, y: offY + (fieldH - 1) - p.y };

name: IC-TOWNMAP3-the-fabric-not-drawn
old:
for (const f of fabric.values())
          if (f.r >= r0 && f.r <= r1 && f.c >= c0 && f.c <= c1) paintFabricCell(ctx, env.view, f);
new: for (const f of fabric.values()) if (f.r >= r0 && f.r <= r1 && f.c >= c0 && f.c <= c1) void f;

name: IC-TOWNMAP3-find-me-off-the-player
old: return viewCentredOn(p.x, p.y, Math.min(SCALE_MAX, Math.max(street, view?.scale ?? 0)), limits);
new: return viewCentredOn(p.x, p.y + 64, Math.min(SCALE_MAX, Math.max(street, view?.scale ?? 0)), limits);
